title: Narcotic
stalemate: The same board keeps returning — there is no further progress

hintReason.remove: All four exposed cards share a rank — discard them together
hintReason.move: Stack pile [{{col}}] onto the pile to its left showing the same rank
hintReason.draw: No move is available — deal one card to each of the four piles
hintReason.redeal: The stock is spent, but the table can be gathered and re-dealt (no limit)

tutorial.columns: Four piles. Only the front card of each is in play.
tutorial.rules: When all four exposed cards share a rank, discard all four together. Suit does not matter.
tutorial.stock: "Deal" gives one card to each of the four piles. Once the stock is spent, "Gather & redeal" keeps the game going — there is no limit.
tutorial.controls: The action buttons: discard, stack, deal and redeal.

landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for easier play

frontendHint.narcoticRemove: All four exposed cards match — discard them
frontendHint.narcoticMove: Stack onto the pile to its left showing the same rank
frontendHint.narcoticDeal: Deal one card to each of the four piles
frontendHint.narcoticRedeal: Gather the table and re-deal (no limit)
